author: SUPUZZ Editorial Team
title: Connect, imagine and play together with SUPUZZ Rainbow Waffle Blocks
description: Explore SUPUZZ Rainbow Waffle Blocks: first builds, color and shape activities, shared play and storage ideas for home or the classroom.
imageAlt: Siblings playing together with SUPUZZ Rainbow Waffle Blocks
intro: What shall we build? Colorful interlocking pieces give children a place to start. Follow an example, change it halfway through or invent something new. The process is part of the play.

hero.alt: Siblings playing together with SUPUZZ Rainbow Waffle Blocks
hero.caption: One idea meets another. Building together is part of the adventure.

connect.title: From flat shapes to a world in three dimensions
paragraphs: Connect pieces sideways, then build upward. Start with a small wall or enclosure and turn it into a house or vehicle. Take it apart and try a different arrangement; finishing a model is only one way to play.

learning.title: Discover color, shape and balance
paragraphs: STEAM brings science, technology, engineering, art and mathematics together. Everyday questions such as “Will it stand?” invite children to observe and try again. Give them time to explain their ideas.
ideas: Sort pieces by color and arrange a favorite sequence.
Turn a flat shape into a standing construction.
Change the base when a tall build falls over.
Give a finished creation a name and a story.

models.title: More than one thing to build
paragraphs: Vehicles, cameras and small playgrounds are starting points. Ask what could change, then make the design your own.

tank.alt: A tank-shaped vehicle made with rainbow waffle blocks
tank.caption: Imagine a vehicle.

playground.alt: A pet playground made with SUPUZZ blocks
playground.caption: Build a little world.

claw.alt: A mechanical claw built with waffle blocks
claw.caption: Explore a mechanism.

together.title: Ideas grow when we play together
paragraphs: One person builds a base while another chooses colors. Children can take different roles and join at their own pace.
PLAY WITH ALL KIDS. We believe play is a universal language of discovery: a way to imagine, build and connect.

family.alt: A grandparent and grandchild building with SUPUZZ blocks
family.caption: What shall we build next? Share ideas across generations.

storage.title: Make cleanup the start of the next adventure
paragraphs: Gather the pieces after play. Sorting by color can be part of tidying, and a photo can save a favorite creation before rebuilding. Storage cases and accessories vary by set; check the selected product.

choosing.title: At home or in the classroom
paragraphs: Try a shared project such as a bridge, or allow time for free building first. For gifts and group activities, check the selected product’s age guidance, piece sizes, contents and instructions.

items.question: What should we build first?
items.answer: Try a small enclosure or a simple house, then change the height or colors.

items.question: Is a storage case included?
items.answer: Some sets include a case. Check the contents of the version you choose.

items.question: Will these fit other brands?
items.answer: Similar shapes do not guarantee matching connectors. Compatibility with other brands is not guaranteed.

items.question: Can schools order in quantity?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us the setting and quantity through the education purchasing inquiry.
